test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 23 Oct, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
A cosmetic company provides five different products. The sales of these five products (in lakh) in the years 2006 and 2012 are shown in the following bar graph.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a5b88fd3677f2d60414a050f2e08fd6ae86adfeb96e6f415d3304f4eecd17f10.png] 

The combined sale of all the five cosmetic products in 2012 increased by what percentage (rounded off to the nearest integer) of the combined sale of all the five cosmetic products in 2006?
solution:
**Formula Used:**

Percentage increase = dfrac{{Total sales in 2012 - Total sales in 2006}}{{Total sales in 2006}} × 100

**Calculation:**

Total sales in 2006 = 36 + 44 + 59 + 40 + 57 = 236

Total sales in 2012 = 42 + 58 + 66 + 78 + 84 = 328

⇒ Percentage increase = ((328 - 236) / 236) × 100

⇒ Percentage increase = (92 / 236) × 100

⇒ Percentage increase = 38.98%

**Rounded off to the nearest integer, the percentage increase is 39%, and the correct answer is option (2).**
